entities.name: Mahitab
entities.description: A pragmatic Amonkheti fighter and former crop-mate of Basri who guides a trek to Temmet's tomb so she and Niharet can afford a home with windows.

entities.name: Niharet
entities.description: Mahitab's beloved friend who was entombed alive as a dissenter and now secretly follows the Chitin Court; she betrays the party.

entities.name: Basri Ket
entities.description: A white-and-gold armored sandbending hero and devotee of Oketra who hires Mahitab to find Temmet.

entities.name: Marunaten
entities.description: One of fifteen-year-old twin embalmers who studied to be viziers of Hazoret.

entities.name: Merinaten
entities.description: The girl twin who is swallowed by a sandwurm and survives.

entities.name: Temmet
entities.description: Oketra's chosen, entombed in a pyramid, whose body is cleansed of corruption by Ketramose.

entities.name: Munhatep
entities.description: An undead skeletal monarch of the Chitin Court who seizes Temmet's body.

entities.name: Ketramose
entities.description: A giant golden lion-faced god, Oketra's son, who tears the pyramid open, cleanses Temmet and claims him as servant.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet, mother of Ketramose, killed by the scorpion.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet whose trials killed many and whom the twins revere.

entities.name: Chitin Court
entities.description: The old insect gods of Amonkhet and their undead monarch followers who live in the Broken Lands.

entities.name: The Great Trespasser
entities.description: The being who decimated Amonkhet and twisted its gods.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: A plane reborn after Bolas's machinations and now rebuilding.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: A healing city on Amonkhet from which Mahitab and the party set out.

entities.name: The Broken Lands
entities.description: The desert crossed by the party, now home to Chitin Court followers.

entities.name: The Hour of Devastation
entities.description: The calamity after which Mahitab freed Niharet.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders whom the Chitin Court is said to have defended against.

events.summary: Basri brings two teenage twin embalmers to Mahitab for a trek to find Temmet, and she objects.
events.quote: You've brought me children.

events.summary: Basri tells Mahitab and Niharet he will pay for the location of Temmet's tomb, which only they know.
events.quote: Mahitab and Niharet were the only remaining members of the crew that had entombed Temmet, the only ones who knew where he could be found.

events.summary: Niharet persuades Mahitab to accept the job by saying they could have a home with windows.
events.quote: Wouldn't it be nice to have a home with windows?

events.summary: Flashback: Niharet was branded a dissenter and entombed alive by angels, then freed by Mahitab after the Hour of Devastation.
events.quote: They wrapped her up and locked her—alive—in that sarcophagus, and then paraded her through the streets.

events.summary: Basri kneels and vows to protect the twins with his life.
events.quote: You have my word. My life for theirs, if that's what it takes.

events.summary: The five set out into the desert at dusk.
events.quote: The five of them set out at dusk.

events.summary: At camp, Niharet suggests other gods protect them, and Basri argues about the Chitin Court.
events.quote: Perhaps we're protected by other gods.

events.summary: A sandwurm erupts from the sand and swallows Merinaten.
events.quote: When the sandwurm erupted from beneath the sands and swallowed Merinaten

events.summary: Basri topples the wurm with sand and Mahitab kills it.
events.quote: she raised up her blade and sank it to the hilt in the creature's head

events.summary: The party pulls Merinaten from the wurm's mouth and binds her wounds.
events.quote: Merinaten screamed, and she was free.

events.summary: Basri carries the injured Merinaten on his back so they can finish the journey.
events.quote: I'll carry Meri.

events.summary: Mahitab finds the half-buried pyramid by the stars.
events.quote: a pyramid, half-buried in the sand, but still the height of five people stacked atop one another

events.summary: Basri uses sandbending to uncover the tomb's buried entrance.
events.quote: He raised his spear and very slowly the sand began to rise.

events.summary: The party finds Temmet's simple sarcophagus in a square chamber.
events.quote: That's Temmet.

events.summary: Seven figures, almost all undead, confront the party in the tomb.
events.quote: Before her stood a group of seven people, and all but one of them undead.

events.summary: Munhatep declares they serve the return of the old ways and claim Temmet's body.
events.quote: We are the loyal followers of the Chitin Court. We serve the return of the old ways.

events.summary: Niharet holds her khopesh at Basri's throat, betraying the party.
events.quote: Niharet was at Basri's back, her khopesh held at his neck.

events.summary: Niharet reveals she wants to restore the Chitin Court as Amonkhet's true gods.
events.quote: I want to bring back the Chitin Court.

events.summary: Munhatep lifts Temmet's body as if weightless.
events.quote: he lifted Temmet as though he weighed nothing more than a grain of sand

events.summary: Basri prays and the top of the pyramid is torn off by a giant.
events.quote: Then the top of the pyramid tore right off.

events.summary: A giant golden lion-faced god holding Oketra's bow appears.
events.quote: A god. It had to be. Its giant golden face was lion-like, with a metallic gilded mane.

events.summary: The god grabs Temmet and flings Munhatep aside.
events.quote: He tossed Munhatep aside

events.summary: The god frees Temmet's body from corruption and Temmet stands alive.
events.quote: Temmet's body was free of corruption.

events.summary: The god names himself Ketramose, Oketra's son, and claims Temmet to serve him.
events.quote: I am Ketramose. Your faith in my mother, Oketra, led me here, to her most loyal servants.

events.summary: Ketramose marches toward Naktamun with Temmet.
events.quote: Ketramose turned his back and began to march toward Naktamun.

events.summary: Niharet tells Mahitab she is leaving with the Chitin Court monarchs.
events.quote: I'm going with the monarchs.

events.summary: Mahitab bitterly leaves with Basri toward his new god.
events.quote: Let's go, Basri. Your new god awaits.

relations.note: Mahitab loves Niharet, who leaves her.

relations.quote: Your faith in my mother, Oketra

relations.note: Monarch who follows the Chitin Court.
relations.quote: We are the loyal followers of the Chitin Court.

relations.note: She joins the Chitin Court's followers.
relations.quote: The followers of the Chitin Court have made the Broken Lands their home.
I thought you were Oketra's man?
they know Temmet was Oketra's chosen
